_comment: Harness fixtures for the synthetic sample library of fixtures/make-sample-library.sh (18 CC0 tracks, 4 artists, 6 albums). Use with HARNESS_FIXTURES=fixtures.sample.json e2e/run.sh <url>. The lb-/la- ids and the lid are hashes of the sample's names and paths (MUSIC_DIR/sample/<Artist>/<Album>/...), stable across fresh installs. No acquiredVideoId: the YouTube-backed steps skip. Keys documented in harness-core.cjs.
